ValidationRule.description: Rule to ensure that Rebate Program Start Date & End Date are within Sales Agreement Dates.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), OR( StartDate < PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.StartDate, EndDate > PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.EndDate ), false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add a Rebate Program that has time duration within the Sales Agreement's time duration.
